QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (line ~568) sets the global pointers to its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`, or to `_mutexed` variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the init function installs mutexed variants when MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is on, and the plain pair otherwise. It doesn't say the choice is made at compile time, but the macro condition implies it.
